body: r22-core (2026-10-07): delivery outbox is at-least-once (a mail can go twice after a crash), max 5 tries, backoff 1m doubling to 1h; the Redis session-cache eviction needs Redis 7 or later. CHANGELOG: ban/revoke/delete drop cached sessions; opt-in delivery outbox (WithDeliveryOutbox, SendOutbox, auth sweep); authtest exports the fault-injecting driver and SweepFaults.
